# Joseph Maina — Digital Marketing Specialist

> Portfolio of Joseph Isaac Maina, a Digital Marketing Specialist based in Nairobi, Kenya. SEO, Meta & TikTok Ads, Google Ads, content strategy, social media management, video production, and graphic design.

Joseph Maina helps brands in Kenya and beyond grow online through paid media, organic search, and creative content. The portfolio showcases case studies, campaigns, services, pricing, experience, and a downloadable CV.

## What I Do

- Digital marketer based in Nairobi, Kenya, running a freelance/agency practice at josephmaina.co.ke.
- Performance marketer managing paid media budgets across Meta, Google, and TikTok for Kenyan SMEs.
- Meta ads management and Meta ads agency services for businesses in Nairobi and across Kenya.
- Google Ads management and PPC campaign management for Kenyan businesses.
- TikTok ads and TikTok marketing for brands targeting Kenyan and East African audiences.
- Social media management — ranked among Kenya's active social media managers, running accounts and campaigns for retail, wellness, and clinic brands.
- SEO consultant helping Nairobi businesses rank on Google, including technical SEO and content strategy.
- Content strategist and video producer for short-form social content (Instagram Reels, TikTok).
- 3+ years of experience; previously Marketing Lead at iClear, where a campaign led to national press coverage.
